items.headline: Coastal Flood Advisory issued November 20 at 12:14PM PST until November 25 at 3:00AM PST by NWS Los Angeles/Oxnard CA
items.description:
* WHAT...Elevated to high surf  will likely continue into much of
next week.For the Coastal Flood Advisory, moderate coastal
flooding expected. For the Coastal Flood Watch, significant
coastal flooding possible.

* WHERE...Ventura County Beaches. Impacts highest across west-
facing beaches, including from Faria Beach to Silverstrand
Beach.

* WHEN...For the Coastal Flood Advisory, from 3 AM Monday to 3
AM PST Wednesday. For the Coastal Flood Watch, from late
Tuesday night through Thursday afternoon.

* IMPACTS...There is a moderate risk for damaging flooding of
sea water over some vulnerable low-lying coastal areas,
especially around the time of high tide, including over
beaches, roads, and structures. Significant beach erosion is
possible.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Highest risk likely Wednesday and Thursday
with potential for significant impacts. Additional products
will likely be needed into Friday.
items.instruction:
Take the necessary actions to protect flood-prone property. Plan
for extra travel time as some roads may be closed.

items.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued November 20 at 12:28PM PST until November 20 at 9:00PM PST by NWS Los Angeles/Oxnard CA
items.description:
* WHAT...Hazardous sea conditions.

* WHERE...East Santa Barbara Channel from Pt. Conception to Pt.
Mugu CA including Santa Cruz Island.

* WHEN...Until 9 PM PST this evening.

* IMPACTS...Conditions will be hazardous to small craft.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...See the Coastal Waters Forecast (CWFLOX)
for more.
items.instruction:
Inexperienced mariners, especially those operating smaller
vessels, should avoid navigating in hazardous conditions.
